title: Call someone from your recent calls
aliases: how do i call someone from recent calls
ring the person who called me
recent calls se phone karna hai
jisne call kiya use wapas phone karo

steps.instruction: Tap "Calls" to see your recent calls.
Tap the phone icon beside the person or number you want to call back.

source_note: Phone on iOS 26/27, English, October 2026 documentation review. Uses Unified layout, where Calls contains recent calls. Classic layout has Recents instead; tapping a row or a phone icon may behave differently with the tap-to-call setting. Assumes the wanted call is visible and is a phone call, not a FaceTime video call. Confirm the layout and call control. Not checked on a phone. Source: https://support.apple.com/en-tm/126076
